Class NetworkDispatch

java.lang.Object
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.core.NetworkDispatch
@Internal public final class NetworkDispatch extends Object
Dispatch of socket, socket channel, datagram, selector and TLS operations, with each call's peer and byte count.

One domain of the dispatch the instrumentation layer calls through the bootstrap bridge; the evaluation it shares with the other domains is DispatchEngine. Not part of the stable API (see ChaosDispatcher).

  • Method Details

    • beforeNioSelect

      public long beforeNioSelect(Object selector, long timeoutMillis) throws Throwable
      Called before Selector.select(): whether the select runs, returns no ready channel at once (a spurious wakeup), or stalls first.
      Parameters:
      selector - the NIO selector being invoked
      timeoutMillis - the requested select timeout in milliseconds
      Returns:
      SELECT_PROCEEDS for normal execution; 0 to return no ready channel at once; a positive count of nanoseconds to stall for first (a timeout()), which the bridge ends early on the selector's wakeup() or close, as a real select ends
      Throws:
      Throwable - if an active scenario throws to simulate a failure

    • beforeSocketRead

      public int beforeSocketRead(Object stream, int len, @Nullable Object remoteAddress, int remotePort, int soTimeoutMillis) throws Throwable
      Called before a socket read to apply scenarios targeting socket reads.
      Parameters:
      stream - the socket implementation being read from
      len - the number of bytes requested
      remoteAddress - the peer InetAddress, or null if not connected
      remotePort - the peer port, or 0 if not connected
      soTimeoutMillis - the socket's SO_TIMEOUT; 0 for infinite
      Returns:
      the byte count to read: len, or less under a TrickleEffect; encoded as -(count) - 1 when the bytes read must be corrupted (see DispatchEngine.corruptFlag)
      Throws:
      Throwable - if an active scenario throws to simulate a failure

    • beforeSocketWrite

      public int beforeSocketWrite(Object stream, int len, @Nullable Object remoteAddress, int remotePort) throws Throwable
      Called before a socket write to apply scenarios targeting socket writes.
      Parameters:
      stream - the socket implementation being written to
      len - the number of bytes being written
      remoteAddress - the peer InetAddress, or null if not connected
      remotePort - the peer port, or 0 if not connected
      Returns:
      the bytes to write: len, or a shorter prefix under a torn write, after which the advice fails the write as a reset connection
      Throws:
      Throwable - if an active scenario throws to simulate a failure

    • beforeSocketChannelRead

      public int beforeSocketChannelRead(Object channel, int remaining) throws Throwable
      Called before SocketChannel.read(java.nio.ByteBuffer) (and its scattering variant): the same SOCKET_READ event as a socket stream read, with the channel's peer and the bytes the buffers can take. A channel has no SO_TIMEOUT, so a TimeoutEffect never fires on it.
      Parameters:
      channel - the channel being read from
      remaining - the bytes the buffers can take
      Returns:
      the byte count to read, as beforeSocketRead(Object, int, Object, int, int)
      Throws:
      Throwable - if an active scenario throws to simulate a failure

    • beforeSocketChannelWrite

      public int beforeSocketChannelWrite(Object channel, int remaining) throws Throwable
      Called before SocketChannel.write(java.nio.ByteBuffer) (and its gathering variant): the same SOCKET_WRITE event as a socket stream write, with the channel's peer and the bytes the buffers hold. A torn write is a short count, which channel callers loop on.
      Parameters:
      channel - the channel being written to
      remaining - the bytes the buffers hold
      Returns:
      the bytes to write: remaining, or fewer under a torn write
      Throws:
      Throwable - if an active scenario throws to simulate a failure

    • beforeSocketBind

      public void beforeSocketBind(Object address, int port) throws Throwable
      Called before a socket is bound (sun.nio.ch.Net.bind): the SOCKET_BIND event, whose address and port are the local ones being bound.
      Parameters:
      address - the local address
      port - the local port; 0 for an ephemeral one
      Throws:
      Throwable - if an active scenario fails the bind

    • beforeDatagram

      public int beforeDatagram(String operation, Object channel, @Nullable Object peer, int length) throws Throwable
      Called before a datagram is sent or received.
      Parameters:
      operation - "DATAGRAM_SEND" or "DATAGRAM_RECEIVE"
      channel - the datagram channel
      peer - the destination of a send (null: the channel's connected peer); ignored for a receive, whose peer is the connected one if any
      length - the datagram's length (send) or the space for it (receive)
      Returns:
      length; ChaosDispatcher.DATAGRAM_DROPPED when a send is suppressed; the DispatchEngine.corruptFlag encoding when the datagram received must be corrupted
      Throws:
      Throwable - if an active scenario fails the call

    • beforeSocketClose

      public void beforeSocketClose(Object socket) throws Throwable
      Called before Socket.close() to apply socket-close scenarios. A failure it throws is the close's: the advice holds it, lets the real close run and throws it after.
      Parameters:
      socket - the socket being closed
      Throws:
      Throwable - if an active scenario throws to simulate a failure
